correctness.rationale: Each nonconstant target needs a distinct exact length-two center with equal flanking letters; constant targets need separate runs of length at least four. The run surplus is therefore at least q(q-1)+3q. Each edge in the cyclic skeleton must support both opposing backtracks, which requires at least three occurrences unless the skeleton is a whole two-run circle. That exception is impossible even for q=2, whose dedicated runs require at least four. The skeleton's degrees are even, forcing q/2 extra edges for even q, and attaining that bound gives exactly a matching. The proposed Euler expansion triples the first traversal of each edge without merging neighboring runs, gives separate center runs and leaves an original occurrence per symbol for its long run. This proves equality and all asserted profiles. Equality in the surplus bound forces all other runs to be singletons and the designated long runs to have length four. Independently reproduced the binary and ternary minima with exact subset DP on cyclic orders of chosen target starts and proper suffix-prefix overlaps, and checked both printed examples directly.
residual_risks: The finite computation verifies the minima only at q=2,3; the general rigidity and construction are analytical.

evidence: In an optimal length-three cover the inspected proof forces exactly two loop traversals for each symbol by equality in the summed counts. Since an aaa already uses two adjacent loops, the only nonsingleton run of that letter is exactly the required triple. The same equality forces each off-diagonal multiplicity to be three in the odd case, and the parity excess to be a perfect matching in the even case. Its constructive proof attains equality for any chosen matching.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Shorten one designated length-four constant run (or one longer run containing the target) per letter and one designated exact double center per ordered off-diagonal pair in an optimal length-four cover. The image is length-three optimal by the exact reduction. Its unique triple runs and singleton others force exactly the frozen long, doubly repeated and singleton runs before shortening. The transition data are unchanged in both directions, and the length-three arbitrary-matching construction transfers back. Thus the unstated rigidity is a direct equality-case corollary, not a surviving independently established result.

evidence: The ordinary-length-four record has the same target set, cyclic wrap-around, allowance of repeats and full parameter range. For all q>=2 there is an exact run-length reduction: in a length-four cover, shorten one chosen long run per letter and one chosen center per distinct ordered pair by one each. Those runs are disjoint, and the result covers aaa and aba. Conversely lengthen a chosen aaa run and one chosen unit center of every nonconstant aba by one each in a length-three cover. Both maps preserve the run-letter skeleton and change length by exactly q^2.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: These maps prove L_4=L_3+q^2 without any new extremal bound and take optimal covers to optimal covers. This is stronger than noticing an algebraic coincidence. Linear superstrings and exact-once universal cycles are not equivalent to the general cyclic at-least-once problem.

originality.rationale: The all-q minimum formula is an exact statement match in the indexed ordinary length-four result. The extra length-four signature is not explicitly stated there, but every component follows directly from the length-three indexed minimum and the equality cases of its loop and transition counts by a reversible change in designated run lengths. This is demonstrable indexed coverage, not a determination of which result was obtained first or a claim of external publication priority.
residual_risks: Catalogue path dates do not locate priority of the underlying results; the frozen reference to a prior length-three classification is not securely identified with the November 22 entry.

Full text of Anisiu et al. (2006) and Simpson (2014), referenced by the length-three record, was not inspected; this does not weaken the actual indexed implication or justify additional claims about historical priority.
